announcements.headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that the board has concluded its meeting and is releasing the outcomes, which typically include routine governance updates or minor operational decisions rather than transformative events.

announcements.headline: Notice of Board Meeting
announcements.insight: A notice of a board meeting is typically an administrative announcement indicating that directors will convene to discuss corporate matters. Without further details, it generally signifies routine governance activity rather than immediate material news for shareholders.
